lessons.text:
Look after people.
They're your army.
lessons.why: The Image: water within the earth is the army, so the realized person embraces the people and cares for the multitude. Both readers saw only hidden water and no lesson.

lessons.text:
Stood on a tiger's
tail. Not bitten.
lessons.why: The Judgment: treading on the tiger's tail, it does not bite the person. Both readers read the old text as a harmless tail; it has to say someone stands on the tail and the tiger still does not bite.

lessons.text:
Parted, they weep.
Met, they laugh.
lessons.why: Line 5: fellowship first weeps and wails, then laughs when the armies manage to meet. Both readers got sad-then-happy but not that the tears come from being apart and the laughter from meeting.

lessons.text:
White horse? Not a
raider. A suitor.
lessons.why: Line 4: a white horse as if winged; this is not an assailant, it is a suitor. Both readers had to guess that the horse was feared as an attack.

The Image: thunder within the earth is return, so the kings closed the passes at the solstice and no one travelled. Both readers asked why they stayed home: the stillness lets what is coming back return.

lessons.text:
Attraction starts
in the big toes.
lessons.why: Line 1: influence in the big toes, the first stirring before anything is said. Both readers could not tell what 'it' was.
Line 4: progressing like a squirrel, skulking and grabbing, is strained because everyone can see it for what it is. Both readers could not tell what the squirrel does wrong.

lessons.text:
Warn your town.
Leave the weapons.
lessons.why: The Judgment: notify your own city; resorting to arms is not supported. Both readers asked what to tell the town and before what.

lessons.text:
Lake gone dry?
Hold to your aim.
lessons.why: The Image: the lake without water is oppression, and the realized person stakes their life on following their purpose. Both readers got the empty lake but no lesson.

lessons.text:
Still the back,
not just the face.
lessons.why: The Judgment: stilling the back, the part you can't see, not only what shows. Both readers asked why the back.
